body.intent: Ship-change fixes red PR CI instead of failing: now that agents run only scoped tests (#259), the PR's GitHub CI is where the rest of the suite runs, so a failing test there must go back to a fixer, not end the run. When pr-green (or rebased-green / landed-green) finds the PR's checks failed with test failures (not infra or flakes already retried), read the failed job log (gh run view --log-failed), turn each failing test or script into a finding, run one fixer cycle on the run worktree with those findings (scoped re-tests of what failed), push, and wait for CI again, within a cap; only then fail. Seen 2026-11-04: actor-dedupe PR #260 failed CI on TestScripts/review-check-worktree and its run failed at pr-green
